content: Design-token lint in practice: stylelint color-no-hex, color-named, declaration-property-value-allowed-list; stylelint-declaration-strict-value (scale-unlimited/declaration-strict-value) enforces var(--x)/$sass/@less for listed props incl regex /color$/, ignoreValues, expandShorthand; Mozilla no-base-design-tokens; Shopify Polaris custom-property-disallowed-list. Tailwind: eslint-plugin-tailwindcss no-arbitrary-value flags text-[#ff0000] p-[13px]; v4 plugin needs cssConfigPath (.css). Approach: parse declared token file for --custom-property names, then flag literal colors and px/rem spacing on color/spacing props not via var().
